purpose: stopping and tipping hold for one operator on stairs
code_or_query:
import math
m_total=72.0 # 60kg parcel + 12kg truck estimate
g=9.81
theta=math.degrees(math.atan2(0.197,0.254)) # max riser over min going
slope_comp=m_total*g*math.sin(math.radians(theta))
# lever: handle 1.1m from axle, load CG 0.25m from axle on tilt
F_hold_tip=m_total*g*0.25/1.1
# tip angle: track half-width 0.25m, CG height 0.6m
tip_angle=math.degrees(math.atan(0.25/0.6))
print(f"stair angle deg {theta:.1f}")
print(f"slope component N {slope_comp:.0f}")
print(f"tip-hold hand force N {F_hold_tip:.0f}")
print(f"lateral tip angle deg {tip_angle:.1f}")
# compare to ISO/Snook limits
print(f"sustained limit ref 80-140 N; initial ref up to 320-340 N")
